name: Venom Bottle
summary: A Venom Bottle holds a vile green venom found among the Witherbarks. An apothecary in Tarren Mill wants a sample.

sections.title: A Vile Sample
sections.body: Among the Witherbarks’ many bottles is one filled with green venom. Its source seems to be an arachnoid creature, and an apothecary in Tarren Mill is eager to examine a sample.

faq.q: What is in a Venom Bottle?
faq.answer: A Venom Bottle holds a vile, green venom. An apothecary in Tarren Mill judges it to come from an arachnoid creature.
An apothecary in Tarren Mill wants a sample of the venom for study.

faq.q: Where did the venom come from?
faq.answer: The apothecary in Tarren Mill judges the venom to come from an arachnoid creature.
